version.description: The semantic version of this generated manifest.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the Cloud Build pipeline ran this audit.

capabilities.description: The deduplicated graph of functional capabilities across the entire platform.

semantic_name.description: The unified human-readable name of the capability (e.g., 'Age Verification Pipeline').

description.description: The aggregated description and constraints of the feature.

source_verticals.description: List of original Markdown files where this capability was requested.

status.description: The true implementation status mapped against the codebase.

agent_claim.description: The UUID of the AI agent currently assigned to build this feature, preventing duplicate work.
